app.title: Qlik Script Studio
app.tagline: Build Qlik load scripts without writing code
app.newProjectConfirm: Replace the current project with an empty one? Export it first if you want to keep it.
app.loadSampleConfirm: Replace the current project with the sample project?
app.importFailed: The file is not a valid Qlik Script Studio project.

steps.sourcesHint: Tell us where the data comes from

linkTypeHints.association: Qlik links the tables automatically through a shared field name. Nothing is merged.
linkTypeHints.leftJoin: Add fields from the other table; keep every row of the table being joined into.
linkTypeHints.rightJoin: Add fields; keep only rows that exist in the other table.
linkTypeHints.innerJoin: Keep only rows that match in both tables.
linkTypeHints.outerJoin: Keep all rows from both tables.
linkTypeHints.leftKeep: Keep both tables but reduce the other one to matching rows.
linkTypeHints.rightKeep: Keep both tables but reduce this one to matching rows.
linkTypeHints.innerKeep: Keep both tables, reduced to matching rows.
linkTypeHints.concatenate: Append the rows of the other table (union).
linkTypeHints.noConcatenate: Load the tables separately even if their fields are identical.
linkTypeHints.applyMap: Look up a value from a mapping table and add it as a new field.

sources.title: Source tables
sources.emptyHint: Add the files or database tables your model reads from, or load the sample project to see how it works.
sources.connectionHint: A Qlik data connection such as lib://DataFiles. Leave empty to use the path as-is.
sources.pathHint: Relative to the connection, e.g. Sales.qvd or 2024/Sales.xlsx
sources.sqlQueryHint: The SELECT statement sent to the database.
sources.inlineHint: First row is the header. Separate values with commas.
sources.keepInModel: Keep this table in the final data model
sources.keepInModelHint: When off, the table is dropped after targets and joins have used it.
sources.noFields: No fields yet. Add them manually, paste a header row, or detect them from a sample file.
sources.pasteHeaderHint: Paste the first line of your file. Commas, semicolons, tabs and pipes are detected automatically.
sources.detectHint: Drop a CSV or Excel file here, or click to choose. Only the header and the first rows are read, in your browser.
sources.duplicateField: Another field in this table already has this name.
sources.how1: Add your source tables and their fields.
sources.how2: Mark which fields are keys, measures and dates (optional).
sources.how3: Shape the final tables, connect them, and copy the script into Qlik.

rolesStep.title: Field roles
rolesStep.empty: Add source tables with fields first
rolesStep.hint: Choose what each field is. Keys link tables, measures get aggregated, dates can drive a master calendar. Ignored fields are not loaded.
rolesStep.suggestionsReady: {{count}} suggestions ready. Review them and apply the ones you agree with.
rolesStep.noSuggestions: No new suggestions. Everything looks assigned.
rolesStep.dateFormatHint: How dates are written in the source, e.g. DD.MM.YYYY. Leave empty for QVD or native dates.
rolesStep.isUniqueHint: Each value appears only once in this table

design.title: Target design
design.emptyHint: A target table is the final shape of your data. Create one, then drag fields into it.
design.primarySourceHint: The table the rows come from. Fields from other tables need a join (see Relations).
design.dropHint: Drag a field from the left, or use the + button on a field.
design.groupByAuto: Group by is created automatically from the non-aggregated columns.
design.noFilter: No filter. All rows are loaded.
design.storePathHint: Leave empty to use the default folder from settings
design.keepInModelHint: When off, the table is dropped at the end of the script (temporary table).
design.previewNoRows: Upload a sample file in step 1 to see example rows.
design.previewAggregated: Aggregated values are computed by Qlik at load time.
design.calendarHint: Creates a Calendar table covering every day between the first and last date of the chosen field.
design.noDateFields: Mark a field as Date in step 2 to enable the master calendar.
design.duplicateName: This name is already used in this table.

formula.title: Calculated field
formula.noMappings: Create an ApplyMap link in Relations first.
formula.rawHint: Written as-is into the script. Use [brackets] around field names with spaces.

relations.title: Relations & joins
relations.emptyHint: Tables appear on the canvas as soon as you add them in the model builder.
relations.canvasHint: Drag from a field handle to a field in another table to create a link.
relations.directionHint: Which table receives the other one's rows or fields.
relations.compositeKeyHint: Two or more matching fields would create a synthetic key. Combine them into one key field.
relations.renameRightToLeft: Rename the field so both tables use the same name
relations.noIssues: No issues found in the data model.
relations.implicit: Automatic association on shared field name

script.title: Script
script.dropConsumed: Drop source tables after they are used
script.errorsHint: Fix these before the script can be generated.
script.empty: Add a source table to see the script here.

diagnostics.EMPTY_PROJECT: The project has no source tables.
diagnostics.DUPLICATE_TABLE_NAME: Two tables are named "{{name}}". Table names must be unique.
diagnostics.INVALID_NAME: The {{what}} name "{{name}}" is not valid. Names cannot contain "]" or line breaks.
diagnostics.EXCEL_SHEET_MISSING: Table "{{table}}" needs an Excel sheet name.
diagnostics.TARGET_PRIMARY_MISSING: Target table "{{table}}" is not built from any table.
diagnostics.FIELD_NOT_FOUND: Table "{{table}}" references a field that no longer exists.
diagnostics.FIELD_NOT_REACHABLE: "{{table}}" uses field "{{field}}" from "{{source}}", but "{{source}}" is not joined into "{{primary}}".
diagnostics.FIELD_IGNORED: "{{table}}" uses field "{{field}}" from "{{source}}", but that field is set to Ignore and is not loaded.
diagnostics.LINK_NO_PAIRS: The link between "{{left}}" and "{{right}}" has no matching fields.
diagnostics.LINK_TABLE_MISSING: A link points to a table that no longer exists.
diagnostics.APPLYMAP_FIELDS_MISSING: The ApplyMap link between "{{left}}" and "{{right}}" is missing its key, value or output field.
diagnostics.CALENDAR_DATE_MISSING: The master calendar has no date field.
diagnostics.CYCLIC_DEPENDENCY: These tables depend on each other in a loop: {{tables}}.
diagnostics.RAW_EXPRESSION_EMPTY: Column "{{column}}" in "{{table}}" has an empty custom expression.
diagnostics.SYNTHETIC_KEY: "{{left}}" and "{{right}}" share more than one field ({{fields}}). Qlik will create a synthetic key.
diagnostics.CIRCULAR_REFERENCE: Circular reference between {{tables}}. Qlik will loosen one table.
diagnostics.KEY_TYPE_MISMATCH: "{{left}}.{{leftField}}" is {{leftType}} but "{{right}}.{{rightField}}" is {{rightType}}. Values may not match.
diagnostics.JOIN_FANOUT_RISK: Joining on "{{fields}}" of "{{table}}" may duplicate rows because the field is not marked unique or as a key.
diagnostics.JOIN_UNINTENDED_COMMON_FIELD: Besides the chosen keys, "{{left}}" and "{{right}}" also share {{fields}}. The join will match on those too.
diagnostics.IMPLICIT_CONCATENATE: "{{left}}" and "{{right}}" have identical fields. Qlik will append them into one table automatically.
diagnostics.DROPPED_TABLE_REFERENCED: "{{by}}" is linked to "{{table}}", but "{{table}}" is dropped at the end of the script.

connect.title: Connect tables
connect.joinHint: One wider table (join). Every row of {{left}} is kept; matching rows of {{right}} fill the new columns.
connect.associationHint: Qlik links them through the shared field (association). Fields stay in their own table.
connect.concatenateHint: Same kind of data from two sources, e.g. 2023 and 2024 (concatenate).
connect.keptSeparate: {{right}} stays a separate table, so its fields are not added to {{target}}.
connect.sameName: Both tables will use the name "{{name}}" for this field.
